'''EasterlingMaster Tatooine Aliens 2''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[EasterlingMaster]]
* '''Published:''' 16 March 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Jabba's Palace|JP-D-tatooinejabbaspalace.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Twi'lek Advisor|JP-D-twilekadvisor.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Den Of Thieves|JP-D-denofthieves.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine: Jabba's Palace
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat TatJP EasterlingMaster DS 2004 5434.txt |Download]]

Hopefully a more effective one then the last.

== Notes ==

* Headers say Locations 4 and Characters 35, but the list has 5 locations and 34 characters; total 60.
* Posted 'Brada' dested Barada; 'EV-909 x2' dested EV-9D9 x2 as posted (unique).
* Ability, Ability, Ability is unmarked, so the printed Cloud City effect.

== Strategy ==

Force Drain a-lot at JP:DW with EV-909. Try to get out some Chevins, I'm trying to get more of 'em, also try to get Tatooine Occupation out quickly. Keep Brada and Ephant Mon by Jabba, while at JP:AC. Keep Stormtroopers at one site then play some TA's. Play Fear and Trinto Duaba when best. But I think I'm gonna' take TD out because of his restiction to play on your battle phase. Other than that, just play along with it and have fun. Thanks.
